verdict.rationale: Mollie documents the monitoring half of this story. Webhooks push real-time payment status updates, next-gen webhooks let you subscribe to specific event types, and a Webhook Events API lets you audit past events. The Payments, Subscriptions and Webhooks APIs are also exposed to agents through an official hosted MCP server. For retries, an agent can create new recurring charges and use the documented Idempotency-Key header to avoid double charges, and Payment Links can be attached to unpaid invoices to share with customers. Missing for 10: no documented failed-payment events or statuses specifically, no built-in smart retry or dunning schedule, no first-party dunning outreach (Mollie does not send reminder emails), and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
